study_design: Case-control study comparing serum biomarkers and seasonal variation between prostate cancer cases and controls
reason: The current analysis compares prostate cancer cases and controls and discusses overall prostate cancer risk. The reference to progression from subclinical to clinically significant disease describes a previous study and does not establish a current aggressive incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Unexpectedly, lower case levels of 1,25-D were limited largely to the summer months (P = 0.01) in both black and white cases and to cases greater than or equal to the median age of 57 years.
estimate_classifications.reason: The comparison concerns serum 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D in prostate cancer cases versus controls, with no aggressive disease definition. A P value is reported without an effect estimate and two 95% confidence bounds.
